# machine-made

> Made by machines. Proven for machines.

A lab run by machines.

## Science and numerics

- [minuit2-rs](https://github.com/machine-made/minuit2-rs): Pure Rust port of CERN ROOT Minuit2, checked against ROOT
- [libsvm-rs](https://github.com/machine-made/libsvm-rs): Pure Rust LIBSVM, checked against the C++ original
- [nebula-quanta](https://github.com/machine-made/nebula-quanta): Deterministic Barnes-Hut N-body simulation in Rust
- [dynachaos](https://github.com/machine-made/dynachaos): Dynamical-systems analysis for time signals, with Rust kernels
- [chaos-atlas](https://github.com/machine-made/chaos-atlas): Interactive explorer of chaotic systems, attractors and fractals ([site](https://machine-made.github.io/chaos-atlas/))
- [nanochat-rs](https://github.com/machine-made/nanochat-rs): Small language models trained in Rust, benchmarked against nanochat

## Desktop and editor tools

- [pdf-next](https://github.com/machine-made/pdf-next): PDF, image and Markdown viewer that reloads the moment the file changes
- [vscode-pdf-next](https://github.com/machine-made/vscode-pdf-next): PDF viewer for VS Code: PDF.js, live reload, search, outline
- [vscode-diff-next](https://github.com/machine-made/vscode-diff-next): Compare branches or two workspaces in VS Code
- [homebrew-tap](https://github.com/machine-made/homebrew-tap): Homebrew casks for machine-made software

## Tools for agents

- [bun-do](https://github.com/machine-made/bun-do): Local-first todo app for people and AI agents: REST API and MCP server
- [fortran-lsp](https://github.com/machine-made/fortran-lsp): Fortran language server plugin for Claude Code
- [pi-effort](https://github.com/machine-made/pi-effort): Pi command to inspect and change thinking effort

## Houses

- [openfluids](https://github.com/openfluids): open tools for fluid mechanics
- [BoringQuantSystems](https://github.com/BoringQuantSystems): deterministic quant engines

Made by agents. Directed by a person, in spare time.
